Class Prefuse3DRadialLayout

java.lang.Object
edu.berkeley.guir.prefuse.action.AbstractAction
edu.berkeley.guir.prefuse.action.assignment.Layout
edu.berkeley.guir.prefuse.action.assignment.TreeLayout
org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.orgchart.ui.prefuse.Prefuse3DRadialLayout
All Implemented Interfaces:
edu.berkeley.guir.prefuse.action.Action, edu.berkeley.guir.prefuse.event.FocusListener, EventListener
public class Prefuse3DRadialLayout extends edu.berkeley.guir.prefuse.action.assignment.TreeLayout implements edu.berkeley.guir.prefuse.event.FocusListener
Performs tree layout using a radial layout, laying out subsequent depth levels of a tree on circles of progressively increasing radius.
